name: @pipeworx/mcp-worldbank-poverty

tools.name: get_poverty
tools.description: Official World Bank poverty & inequality estimates for a country (or all countries). Returns poverty headcount, poverty gap, poverty severity, Gini, mean & median welfare (income or consumption, $/day in 2017 PPP), income deciles, and population in poverty. Use povline to pick the international line: 2.15 (extreme poverty), 3.65 (lower-middle-income), 6.85 (upper-middle-income).

country.description: ISO3 country code (e.g. "BRA", "IND", "NGA") or "all" for every country. Default "all".

year.description: Reporting year (e.g. "2020") or "all" for the full time series. Default "all".

povline.description: Poverty line in $/day (2017 PPP). Common values: 2.15, 3.65, 6.85. Default 2.15.

fill_gaps.description: If true, interpolate/extrapolate estimates for years without a survey. Default false (survey years only).

tools.name: get_poverty_regional
tools.description: Aggregated World Bank poverty estimates at the regional/group level (not per-country). Returns headcount, poverty gap, mean welfare, and total population in poverty for each group. group_by controls the aggregation: "wb" = World Bank geographic regions, "inc" = income groups (HIC/UMIC/LMIC/LIC), "none" = global total.

povline.description: Poverty line in $/day (2017 PPP). Common values: 2.15, 3.65, 6.85. Default 2.15.

group_by.description: Aggregation: "wb" geographic regions, "inc" income groups, "none" global total. Default "wb".

tools.name: list_reference
tools.description: Reference / metadata for the PIP dataset. table="versions" lists available data releases & PPP rounds; table="aux_list" lists all auxiliary tables; any other value (e.g. "countries", "regions", "poverty_lines", "indicators", "dictionary") returns that auxiliary table. Use to look up valid country codes, region mappings, or supported indicators.

table.description: "versions", "aux_list", or an auxiliary table name like "countries" | "regions" | "poverty_lines" | "indicators" | "dictionary". Default "versions".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-worldbank-poverty forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the worldbank-poverty pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
